_comment: Checks for ~/.claude/workflows/director.js, modelled on geolarp's director.json; run each from a worktree root.
All three checks were proven green (exit 0) on origin/main a2eec431 (2026-10-08), one at a time: CHECK_IMAGE 0s on a warm layer cache (about 10 minutes cold), CHECK_SUITE 84s, CHECK_BUILD 64s.
Where Docker's credential helper can't run (WSL interop off), prefix each with `export DOCKER_CONFIG=<dir with {"auths":{}}>;`.
The empty env file exists because compose requires env_file; CI runs without secrets (Supabase is mocked), so the checks do too, and the real one is never copied into a worktree.

The read-only mount of the git common dir is there because a worktree's .git points into the main repo's git dir, which the git-based tests need; `--ignore-scripts` skips `prepare`, which would otherwise write core.hooksPath into the shared config.
GIT_AUTHOR_* are set because compose sets GIT_COMMITTER_NAME from GIT_AUTHOR_NAME, which is empty when unset and breaks tests that make temporary commits.
The throwaway /app/node_modules and /app/.next volumes are seeded from the image per run, and `-p rescuedogs-wf` keeps one image for all worktrees without touching the dev stack's volumes.
CHECK_SUITE mirrors ci.yml: detect-project, lint, type-check, check:icons, `pnpm test --run` (368 files, 3993 tests) and test:scripts (139 pass).
CHECK_BUILD uses NEXT_PUBLIC_DEPLOY_URL=https://raisedpaws.com to match public/CNAME and robots.txt, and fails if the build leaves tracked changes, except public/feed.json.

public/feed.json is excluded from that diff and restored afterwards because it is committed with the old tortoisewolfe.github.io URLs and the build rewrites it to the live domain, so including it would fail on a clean origin/main.

These checks do NOT cover coverage thresholds (`pnpm test:coverage`), Storybook (`build-storybook`), Playwright E2E, Pa11y accessibility, the component-structure workflow, the smoke or monitor workflows, deploy.yml, or anything needing real Supabase credentials.
validate:breakpoints and the rebrand test are left out of CHECK_SUITE because ci.yml does not run them, not because they fail.

checks.CHECK_SUITE: [ -f .env ] || : > .env; G=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir); GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=director-check GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=director-check@localhost docker compose -p rescuedogs-wf run --rm --no-deps -T -v /app/node_modules -v /app/.next -v "$G":"$G":ro -e NEXT_PUBLIC_DEPLOY_URL=https://raisedpaws.com --entrypoint sh rescuedogs -c 'set -e; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts --prefer-offline; node scripts/detect-project.js >/dev/null; pnpm lint; pnpm type-check; pnpm check:icons; pnpm test --run; pnpm test:scripts; echo SUITE_OK'
checks.CHECK_BUILD: [ -f .env ] || : > .env; G=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir); GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=director-check GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=director-check@localhost docker compose -p rescuedogs-wf run --rm --no-deps -T -v /app/node_modules -v /app/.next -v "$G":"$G":ro -e NEXT_PUBLIC_DEPLOY_URL=https://raisedpaws.com --entrypoint sh rescuedogs -c 'set -e; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts --prefer-offline; node scripts/detect-project.js >/dev/null; pnpm build; echo BUILD_OK' && git diff --exit-code --stat -- . ':!public/feed.json'; rc=$?; git checkout -q -- public/feed.json; exit $rc
